en: Dependent on a state that is accompanied by clinging (*saraṇa*) and is to be abandoned by vision, there arises a state not accompanied by clinging and not to be abandoned by vision, by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*). Under the root condition: one [formula] … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: one.

Dependent on a state that is accompanied by clinging and is to be abandoned by cultivation (*bhāvanā*), there arises a state not accompanied by clinging and not to be abandoned by cultivation, by way of the root condition. Under the root condition: one … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: one.

Conditioned by a state that is non-conflict (*araṇa*) and is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation, there arises a state that is non-conflict and is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation, by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*). There is one [condition] under root; ... pe ... there is one under non-disappearance (*avigata*).
